name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, back flat.
Extend your right arm forward and your left leg back at the same time until both are in line with your torso.
Pause briefly without letting your hips rotate or your lower back sag, then return to the start.
Repeat with the opposite arm and leg, alternating sides.
image_prompt_scene: On hands and knees with the spine neutral and the back flat.
